name: Image Wall
description: A tilted wall of images whose columns drift in opposite directions.

props.name: images
props.description: Image sources, dealt into the columns in turn. A plain string is treated as decoration and gets empty alt text; pass { src, alt } when a picture carries meaning.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of columns, from 1 to 8. Neighbouring columns drift in opposite directions at slightly different speeds.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for a column to travel the length of its images once. Each column varies it a little.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which clips the wall and fades its edges. Give it a height. Other div props are passed through.
